note: Mixed page (filename school tag ignored). Lines 1-14 playground aides (Elementary School / Elementary Annex -> unknown). Merchant resigned 11/30/73 and Goubeaud replaced her; both kept. HEALTH SERVICES: physician district-wide; nurses by printed building (Elementary unknown, Middle, High). Custodial Services is a two-column layout Textract interleaved: Lemieux is Supervisor/Foreman of Buildings & Grounds, office Brooks House -> central-office. Toland resigned 11/16/73 and is replaced at High School by Ebersole, so Toland high. High School column (printed 'HIGH SCHOOL:' line 34 label ordering is jumbled): Paton, Ebersole, Jullano (replacing Bellafiore who went to Middle School), and by column position Letarte and Massak (INFERRED, left column continues past the right column's end). Middle School column: Carrier, Abare, Bellafiore, Munro. Lines 30-54 school attributions were reasoned from the replacement notes; Letarte/Massak least certain. Mrs./Dr. dropped.  Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
